encounters.title: Mirage Caravan
encounters.description: Fresh tracks vanish beneath an abandoned caravan.
encounters.resolved_description: Only cooling sand remains around the caravan.

choices.label: Follow the tracks
choices.result: The trail reveals a useful shortcut, but the heat bites hard.

choices.label: Search the wagon
choices.result: A careful search uncovers an old traveler's clue.

encounters.title: Whispering Cairn
encounters.description: A mossy stone pile repeats fragments of your thoughts.

choices.label: Answer the whisper
choices.result: The forest tests your nerve and yields a hidden truth.

choices.label: Study the markings
choices.result: The old trail marks reveal who passed this way.

encounters.title: Broken Supply Lift
encounters.description: A loaded platform hangs from one badly frayed rope.
encounters.resolved_description: The lift's rope hangs loose against the rock.

choices.label: Climb onto it
choices.result: The risky ascent gives you a commanding view of the route.

choices.label: Inspect the cargo
choices.result: The manifests expose the enemy's supply route.

encounters.title: Storm Ledge
encounters.description: Lightning exposes two routes across a narrow ledge.
encounters.resolved_description: The worst of the storm has passed.

choices.label: Cross immediately
choices.result: You beat the storm and memorize the high route.

choices.label: Find cover
choices.result: Patience reveals a safer path through the rocks.

encounters.title: Cold Campfire
encounters.description: A recently abandoned camp hides signs of a hurried escape.
encounters.resolved_description: The searched camp offers no further clues.

choices.label: Read the journal
choices.result: The final entry names a danger waiting deeper inside.

choices.label: Follow the drag marks
choices.result: The trail teaches you plenty, painfully.
